dogecoin.text:
Musk hasn't just jumped the shark with #dogecoin, he jumped the entire shiver. 

a joke (coin) well past the point of amusement. @elonmusk using his considerable marketing prowess on SNL then separately both SpaceX & $TSLA to pump in span of 4 days.

Whatever this is, ain't right

We've reached the point in the cycle where Musk has to spend billions propping up a joke ( #dogecoin) that only has negative externalities in order to support the equity of an OEM worth more than every other Auto OEM combined ( $TSLA)
